events.description: A free weekly club where children from the Homework Club at the Beach Flats Community Center tend their own zone of the garden. events.organizer: City of Santa Cruz Parks & Recreation

events.title: Protect Your Soil in Heavy Rain: Actionable Strategies for Wet Weather
events.description: With El Nio expected to bring significant rainfall this season, safeguarding your garden's foundation is more critical than ever. Join the UC Master Gardeners and the UCSC Center for Agroecology for a timely, practical workshop dedicated to protecting and preserving your garden soil during severe wet weather.

events.title: First Saturday Tour at the Arboretum
events.description: A docent-led introduction to the Arboretum's plant collections and wildlife. Each tour varies with the season and guide. Admission is $13; current members are free. Limited to 15 people; unsuitable weather cancels.

events.title: Volunteer Workday at the UCSC Farm
events.description: Please join us for a day of harvesting, cleaning and storing dahlia tubers for the winter.
